payload.text: Put to hv after the 13:00Z compact (ic's note with issue 0717, 12:19Z): intent doctor is declared read in the register, yet by default it creates a missing store and migrates an older one, one way. Either re-declare it as a write, or make it never write by default (option 3 of 0717, a change of behaviour). Every fix found rides this release (hv decision 69), so the call is which fix. vc to frame both with ic's and cc's views before putting it.
